title: Understanding React Hooks
content: React Hooks are functions that let you use state and other React features without writing a class. They were introduced in React 16.8 and have become a fundamental part of modern React development.
author: John Doe

title: JavaScript ES6 Features
content: ES6, also known as ECMAScript 2015, introduced many new features to JavaScript, including arrow functions, classes, template literals, and destructuring. These features make JavaScript more powerful and easier to work with.
author: Jane Smith
